easyhopper.title: Easy Hopper
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.easyhoppe: Speed up hoppers, or enable filtering without using new block
easyhopper.toast.title: Cannot Open Config
easyhopper.toast.description: Requires Cloth Config or YACL mod to be installed!
easyhopper.config.edit_in_config_only: This option can only be modified in the config file
easyhopper.gui.notice.syncing: Fetching latest config from server, please wait...
easyhopper.HOPPER_TRANSFER_COOLDOWN.tool: Controls the cooldown for item transfer by the hopper
easyhopper.HOPPER_INPUT_COUNT.tooltip: Controls the number of items transferred by the hopper at one time
easyhopper.HOPPER_OUTPUT_COUNT.tooltip: Controls the number of items outputted by the hopper at one time
easyhopper.HOPPER_FILTERING.tooltip: If enabled, the last slot of the hopper will act as a filtering slot, and only the same type as the filtering slot can transfer
easyhopper.HOPPER_BETTER_EXTRACT.tooltip:
1. If a container or full-cube block on the hopper, it will stop searching for entities
2. Reduce the number of chest updates caused by hoppers
easyhopper.HOPPER_BETTER_EXTRACT.disable: Starting with version 1.20.5, Mojang has improved the hopper code, which means this feature is no longer needed
easyhopper.HOPPER_EXTRACT_COOLDOWN.toolt: Limit the frequency of hopper searching for entities
easyhopper.HOPPER_MINECART_TRANSFER_COOL: Controls the cooldown for item transfer by the hopper minecart
easyhopper.HOPPER_MINECART_BETTER_EXTRAC: Limit the frequency of hopper minecart searching for items
easyhopper.ALLOW_OP_MODIFY.tooltip: Whether to allow operators (OP) to modify configurations in-game; otherwise, modifications can only be made via the config file.
